title: Interface Conditions for Wave Propagation Through a Time-varying Metasurface
summary: We study wave propagation through a time-modulated thin heterogeneous layer. The layer is assumed to have a thickness of order $\es\ll 1$ and its material properties exhibit rapid oscillations on multiple spatial and temporal scales. We aim to rigorously derive the effective model and the corresponding interface conditions for wave propagation through the limiting interface. To perform the homogenization together with dimension reduction, we generalize the notion of two-scale convergence for thin layer introduced by Neuss-Radu and Jäger (2007) to a multiple space-time scale framework.
